summary: Spell out numbers one to nine and use numerals for 10 and up, except for forms like '4 million' or '4 GB' and in tables or charts.
questions: Should I write numbers as words or digits in docs?

answer_card.title: Numbers
answer_card.answer_md: Spell out one through nine; use numerals for 10+. Exceptions: "4 million", "4 GB", and tables/charts.
